requirements: one row per canonical selected normative ID in canonical order: id,requiredProfile,ownerId|null,readiness(existing six-state planner spelling),declaredWholeContract(boolean),wholeClauseQualification(unestablished),observation|null,missingSetup[],missingApplicability[],blockedPrerequisites[]. No missing ID is dropped.
observation: ownerId,rawWrapperSha256,canonicalResultSha256,rowIndex,state,category|null,authoredAssertionInventoryDigest,authoredAssertionsAllPassed(boolean|null),reportedCleanupState,ownershipVerification(unverified). Only fixed categories/known manifest IDs/digests/counts are serialized; no request/response body, raw header, arbitrary message/reason/exception, resolver or credential string. Preserve raw actual wrapper only via existing protected writer; this slice makes no new raw copy.
declaredFlags: RU current34 copied as declared flags; TX allfalse. Every wholeClauseQualification stays unestablished in this private carrier, regardless of declared flag/pass. Independent full governing-clause review plus actual final installed qualification belongs later.
nonRequiredReportRows: exact known unfiltered metadata rows(5 diagnostics) retained as separate no-credit projection; no unknown/extra or wrong-profile rows; do not count diagnostics in requiredIds or planned owners
reports: ordered ownerId + exact source/artifact/route/config digests and actual selected/result ID arrays + lifecycle/byte identity; no raw secret-bearing text
attempt: same existing outcome/failure-stage facts, states and result references; expected counts distinct from actual returned/validated/settled facts; missing is null/unobserved rather than zero
unresolvedConditions: explicit D2S1/G2 where affected, D3 cold/intended-listener/admission, D4 administration/restore and final combined source/config/provenance. Missing setup/applicability never certifies N/A. No resolved/waived status introduced.
limitations: source-private carrier only; no public admission or proof token
trusted-source identity equality does not prove run truth
source/historical/data-unit observations never current installed qualification
reported cleanup is not verified child/owner closure
final combined basis unbound; incoming startup/D3a not adopted
canonicalEncoding: canonicalJson from existing module then UTF8, SHA256 raw serialized bytes; verify canonical bytes exactly and recompute every projection from independently supplied bound inputs/reports, rather than trust candidate counters/flags.
